subject: ROCKBEASTS Demo
purpose: Creative reference for color, lighting, character acting, themed interfaces and narrative craft in OpenLegend.
storage_boundary: Git contains notes and metadata only. Official images are embedded from their original Steam URLs. Selected captures are preserved in the authenticated reference archive identified below; no OpenLegend project study-storage publication is claimed.
rights: Copyright remains with the respective creators.
rights_note: Third-party reference material for study; public availability does not grant production reuse rights. No license to reuse game art is asserted.
build_note: Trailer and screenshot build identifiers and capture settings are unknown.
dimension_note: Image and video dimensions describe supplied files, not internal game rendering resolution.
verification: Downloaded files decoded and selected images visually checked. Frame sequences support limited acting observations, not a hands-on animation, latency or branching test.
capture_tool: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
capture_recipe: Full-frame JPEG extraction with FFmpeg at the listed timestamp. R04 was decoded from the beginning using ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -ss 42.8 -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 output.jpg. Other full frames use -ss before -i. Sequence strips resize selected frames to 640x360 and add source/time labels.
